logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Clean technical illustration for a pump-module decision report. Layout: top strip shows a six-step qualification workflow (screen eligibility, juxtapose quality and defects, rank measured energy, qualify lowest energy, lock decision, close open questions) as rounded boxes with arrows. Main panel: horizontal bar chart of measured acceptance-run energy for four modules, P2 shortest bar highlighted with a 'recommended' tag; P4 bar marked 'sole zero-defect module, reliability question open'. Each module labeled with quality index and defect count. Small side vignette of a pump impeller and transfer-loop piping in flat muted blue. Common fixed-duty note under the chart. No decorative clutter; sans-serif labels, flat vector style.
